verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) is documented as a separate API/SMTP service for event-driven, one-to-one messages (receipts, notifications) alongside the Marketing API, matching the story's intent (mailchimp-docs-2, docs-6, docs-18). However, community reports state Mandrill remains poorly integrated with the main Mailchimp platform years after being combined, and describe abrupt service shutoffs without warning, undermining the 'same platform' unified experience (mailchimp-comm-4, mailchimp-comm-5, mailchimp-comm-8). missing for 10: evidence of a unified account/API surface between Marketing and Transactional, and independent confirmation that reliability issues have been resolved.
